purpose: Define a lawful public metadata lane for Old Phrygian object-level enrichment without treating modern web presentations as independent critical editions.

source.name: Phrygian Monuments
source.site_rights_statement: Site states that pictures taken by its author/associates may be used for non-commercial and academic purposes with reference; contact requested for higher resolution/other use.
source.project_policy: Do not bulk-copy images or source transcriptions. Use attributed factual object/layout/direction metadata only after record-specific inspection; preserve source reading as a dependent presentation citing Brixhe-Lejeune/Obrador-Cursach.

expansion_rule: This source can support record-by-record public factual metadata enrichment where inspected. It cannot by itself turn dependent displayed readings into independently verified canonical texts.

monumental_discovery_register.scope_note: Public Phrygian Monuments index states it covers almost all inscriptions on rock and detached stone monuments, excluding most smaller sherd/metal/seal material. Treat as scoped discovery, not exhaustive Phrygian corpus.

groups.context: Bithynia/Daskyleion group as labelled by source

exclusions: small-object corpus not covered by this discovery register
group labels do not certify physical-object counts
monumental_discovery_register.source_lineage: Index says classification follows Obrador-Cursach Lexicon; individual pages cite Brixhe-Lejeune 1984 and Obrador-Cursach. Therefore catalogue overlap is dependent scholarship, not independent reading confirmation.
